Reuse the already catalog-provisioned preallocated application, exact scenario-specific grants and existing Playwright/MSTest/native host. Preserve ordinary A/B isolation and original-key/ETag authority. Qualify the compatible remaining WORK-168 mixed applied/pending/rejected/restart/stale/offline/noInstances, bounded page, desired/history and session/map/delay semantics through the current layout. No new controls, normal canary wizard, production fake history, package, test harness or Scheduler implementation.
tasks.validation: New named journeys must check the actual current UI and native calls, exact UTF-8/SHA/immutable pairs, zero enrollment for predeployment, no effects on storage/session/read-only paths, scoped original decisions and payload-free Audit, and actual callback/browser/host/provider cleanup. Join every route callback and response observer even on failure. Reuse Configuration fingerprints and existing public controls; include scoped formatting, builds, appropriate regressions, independent review and current coverage/docs in this leaf. Source work may proceed independently while shared native execution follows the diagnosis leaf.
